headline: Advances in Cavity QED, Quantum Transducers & Sensing
summary: Today's papers explore physical platforms for quantum technology, ranging from multi-atom cavity QED arrays to integrated mechano-quantum sensing devices. They investigate how quantum information and sensitivity propagate across spins, bosonic baths, and micro-mechanical strains.

themes.title: Cavity QED with Atom Tweezers
themes.body: Researchers demonstrate site-resolved optical tweezer arrays of up to 36 rubidium atoms inside a fiber Fabry-Perot microcavity, achieving high single-atom cooperativity alongside individual spin control.

themes.title: Spin Systems for Quantum Sensing
themes.body: Studies investigate spin dynamics in open environments and solid-state hosts, demonstrating strain transducing in van der Waals defect hosts and mapping quantum sensitivity flow across spin chains coupled to bosonic baths.

connections.body: Both papers investigate spin couplings to external modes for sensing, contrasting theoretical sensitivity flow in bosonic baths with practical strain transduction in defect centers.
